title: The Wardrobe of Milton Flats
author: Odile Ashgrove
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
